name: Adaptive Sampling Scheduler
description: Given the current ConfidenceSnapshot from the Confidence Engine, determines whether THIS specific request should be a coaching sample (sent to both local and remote). In Phase 1: all requests go to remote (100%). In Phase 2: all requests go to both (100% coaching). In Phase 3: sampling rate is a continuous function of current correlation score, computed via configurable decay function (exponential, linear, or step — defined in config). Has a hard minimum floor (config: min_floor, default 2%) — never stops spot-checking. Forces 100% sampling when correlation < coaching_trigger. Forces full remote (no local) when correlation < emergency_threshold. Staleness override: forces a coaching sample if the confidence engine signals staleness. The decision for each request is made by generating a random float and comparing against the current sampling rate. Returns a SamplingDecision with routing booleans, phase label, effective rate, and human-readable reason string. The scheduler is entirely stateless — all state arrives via ConfidenceSnapshot. The random source is injected for deterministic testing. Config validation fails fast at startup. All decisions are serializable for the JSON audit trail.

types.name: SamplingPhase
types.description: Emergent phase label derived from the current ConfidenceSnapshot. Phases are never manually triggered — they are computed on every call from correlation score, sample count, staleness, and budget state.

types.name: DecayFunctionName
types.description: The name of a registered decay function that maps correlation score to sampling rate. Selected via config and resolved at scheduler construction time.

types.name: DecayFunctionParams

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Exponential decay rate constant. Used by 'exponential' decay. Higher values cause faster decay of sampling rate as correlation increases.

validators.error_message: Exponential decay rate must be positive

fields.name: high_correlation_rate
fields.description: Sampling rate at the high-correlation end for linear interpolation. Used by 'linear' decay.

fields.name: low_correlation_rate
fields.description: Sampling rate at the low-correlation end for linear interpolation. Used by 'linear' decay.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Ordered list of (correlation_threshold, sampling_rate) pairs for 'step' decay. Each element is a two-element list [threshold: float, rate: float]. Must be sorted ascending by threshold. The rate for the highest threshold <= current correlation is used.

validators.expression: all(len(s) == 2 and 0.0 <= s[0] <= 1.0 and 0.0 <= s[1] <= 1.0 for s in value)
validators.error_message: Each step must be [threshold, rate] with both values in [0.0, 1.0]

validators.expression: all(value[i][0] < value[i+1][0] for i in range(len(value)-1))
validators.error_message: Steps must be sorted ascending by correlation threshold

types.description: Parameters for the configurable decay function. Which fields are used depends on the chosen DecayFunctionName. All have sensible defaults so only the relevant ones need be specified in config.

types.name: SamplingSchedulerConfig

fields.name: emergency_threshold
fields.description: If correlation_score < emergency_threshold, force REMOTE_ONLY phase — local model is too unreliable to serve. Must be strictly less than coaching_trigger.

fields.name: coaching_trigger
fields.description: If correlation_score < coaching_trigger (and >= emergency_threshold), force COACHING_FULL phase — 100% of requests are coaching samples (sent to both local and remote). Must be strictly less than adaptive_entry_correlation.

fields.name: adaptive_entry_correlation
fields.description: Minimum correlation score to enter ADAPTIVE phase. When correlation >= this value, sampling rate is computed via the decay function. Below this (but >= coaching_trigger), the system remains in COACHING_FULL.

fields.name: min_floor
fields.description: Hard minimum sampling rate — the system never stops spot-checking. In ADAPTIVE phase, the effective rate is max(decay_function(correlation), min_floor). Default 2%.

validators.error_message: min_floor must be in (0.0, 1.0] — zero floor is not permitted, spot-checking must never stop

fields.name: min_sample_count_for_adaptive
fields.description: Minimum number of coaching samples that must have been collected before the scheduler can enter ADAPTIVE phase. Below this count, COACHING_FULL is forced regardless of correlation score. Prevents premature confidence in correlation.

fields.name: decay_function_name
fields.description: Name of the decay function to use for computing sampling rate in ADAPTIVE phase. Must be one of the registered decay function names: 'exponential', 'linear', 'step'.

fields.name: decay_params
fields.description: Parameters passed to the selected decay function. Which fields matter depends on decay_function_name.

types.description: Pydantic model holding all configuration for the Adaptive Sampling Scheduler. Validated strictly at construction time (fail fast). Cross-validation ensures threshold ordering: 0 <= emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < adaptive_entry_correlation <= 1.0 and min_floor <= 1.0. Loaded from the top-level YAML config 'sampling' section.

types.name: ConfidenceSnapshot

fields.name: correlation_score
fields.description: Current correlation score between local model outputs and remote model outputs, as computed by the Confidence Engine. Range [0.0, 1.0]. A value of 0.0 means no correlation data yet (Phase 1 / initial state).

fields.name: is_stale
fields.description: True if the Confidence Engine has flagged the correlation data as stale (e.g., no coaching samples collected within the staleness window). Forces a coaching sample regardless of the computed phase.

fields.name: sample_count
fields.description: Total number of coaching samples collected so far. Used to determine whether sufficient data exists to enter ADAPTIVE phase (must be >= config.min_sample_count_for_adaptive).

fields.name: budget_exhausted
fields.description: True if the budget controller reports the remote API budget is exhausted. When true, the scheduler forces LOCAL_ONLY phase — no remote calls are made. This is the highest-priority override.

types.description: Immutable snapshot of the current confidence state, produced by the Confidence Engine. Passed into the scheduler on every request. This is the sole source of truth for phase determination — the scheduler holds no internal state.

types.name: SamplingDecision

fields.name: send_to_local
fields.description: If True, the request should be routed to the local model for inference.

fields.name: send_to_remote
fields.description: If True, the request should be routed to the remote API for inference.

fields.name: is_coaching_sample
fields.description: Computed field: True iff send_to_local AND send_to_remote are both True. When True, the responses will be compared by the Confidence Engine to update correlation.

fields.name: sampling_rate
fields.description: The effective sampling rate that was computed for this decision, after all overrides and floor clamping. Range [0.0, 1.0]. In forced phases (REMOTE_ONLY, COACHING_FULL, LOCAL_ONLY) this is 1.0.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: The emergent phase label computed for this request based on the ConfidenceSnapshot.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Human-readable explanation of why this decision was made. Includes the override that triggered (if any), the computed rate, and the random roll result. For audit trail and debugging.

types.description: Frozen (immutable) Pydantic model representing the scheduler's decision for a single request. Serializable to JSON for the structured audit trail. Validated: at least one of send_to_local or send_to_remote must be True — a request is never dropped. is_coaching_sample is a computed property: True when both send_to_local and send_to_remote are True.

types.name: RandomSource

fields.name: description
fields.description: A callable with signature () -> float returning a value in [0.0, 1.0). Injected at scheduler construction for deterministic testing.

types.description: Protocol / interface for the injectable random number source. In production, wraps random.random(). In tests, can return deterministic sequences. The scheduler calls random_source() to get a float in [0.0, 1.0). This is modeled as a callable that takes no arguments and returns a float.

types.name: DecayFunction

fields.name: description
fields.description: A callable with signature (correlation: float, params: DecayFunctionParams) -> float. Returns the raw sampling rate before floor clamping.

types.description: Protocol / interface for decay functions. A decay function takes a correlation score (float in [0.0, 1.0]) and the DecayFunctionParams, and returns a sampling rate (float in [0.0, 1.0]). Three concrete implementations are provided: exponential_decay, linear_decay, step_decay. The scheduler resolves the concrete function from config.decay_function_name at construction time.

functions.name: AdaptiveSamplingScheduler.__init__
functions.description: Construct the scheduler with validated config and an injectable random source. Resolves the decay function from config.decay_function_name at construction time. Validates all config cross-constraints (threshold ordering). Fails fast with a clear error if config is invalid — never silently defaults.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Fully validated sampling scheduler configuration. Cross-validation must pass: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < adaptive_entry_correlation.

inputs.name: random_source
inputs.description: Injectable callable () -> float returning a value in [0.0, 1.0). Defaults to stdlib random.random. Inject a deterministic source for testing.

error_cases.name: invalid_config
error_cases.condition: Config Pydantic validation fails (type errors, range violations)

error_data.message: Threshold ordering violated: must have emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < adaptive_entry_correlation

error_cases.name: unknown_decay_function
error_cases.condition: config.decay_function_name does not match any registered decay function (should not happen with enum, but guarded)

error_cases.name: invalid_step_config
error_cases.condition: decay_function_name is 'step' but decay_params.steps is empty

error_data.message: Step decay function requires at least one step in decay_params.steps

preconditions: config is a valid SamplingSchedulerConfig instance (Pydantic validation passed)
random_source returns float in [0.0, 1.0) on each call
postconditions: Scheduler instance is ready to accept should_sample calls
The decay function corresponding to config.decay_function_name is resolved and bound
Config is immutable after construction — no runtime config changes

structured_side_effects.description: Logs scheduler construction with resolved config at INFO level

functions.name: should_sample
functions.description: The single public method. Given a ConfidenceSnapshot, determines the emergent phase and whether this specific request should be a coaching sample. Override precedence chain (highest to lowest priority): (1) budget_exhausted → LOCAL_ONLY, (2) correlation < emergency_threshold → REMOTE_ONLY, (3) correlation < coaching_trigger → COACHING_FULL, (4) is_stale → COACHING_FULL (staleness override), (5) sample_count < min_sample_count_for_adaptive → COACHING_FULL, (6) correlation < adaptive_entry_correlation → COACHING_FULL, (7) ADAPTIVE phase: compute rate via decay_function(correlation, params), clamp to max(rate, min_floor), roll random, route accordingly. In ADAPTIVE phase: if random_roll < effective_rate → coaching sample (both=True); else → local only. Returns a frozen SamplingDecision.

inputs.name: snapshot
inputs.description: Current confidence state from the Confidence Engine. Must be a valid ConfidenceSnapshot with all fields populated.

error_cases.name: invalid_snapshot
error_cases.condition: snapshot fails ConfidenceSnapshot Pydantic validation (e.g. correlation_score out of range, missing fields)

preconditions: snapshot is a valid ConfidenceSnapshot instance
The scheduler has been successfully constructed via __init__
postconditions: Returned SamplingDecision has at least one of send_to_local or send_to_remote set to True
SamplingDecision.is_coaching_sample == (send_to_local AND send_to_remote)
If snapshot.budget_exhausted is True: phase == LOCAL_ONLY, send_to_local == True, send_to_remote == False
If not budget_exhausted and snapshot.correlation_score < config.emergency_threshold: phase == REMOTE_ONLY, send_to_remote == True, send_to_local == False
If phase == COACHING_FULL: send_to_local == True, send_to_remote == True, sampling_rate == 1.0
If phase == ADAPTIVE: sampling_rate >= config.min_floor
If phase == ADAPTIVE and send_to_remote == False: send_to_local == True (local-only serving in adaptive)
If phase == ADAPTIVE and send_to_remote == True: send_to_local == True (coaching sample in adaptive)
SamplingDecision.reason is non-empty and human-readable
SamplingDecision.phase matches the computed emergent phase
SamplingDecision is frozen (immutable) after construction

structured_side_effects.description: Logs every sampling decision as structured JSON at DEBUG level for audit trail. Includes snapshot, computed phase, effective rate, random roll value, and final decision.

functions.name: exponential_decay
functions.description: Computes sampling rate using exponential decay: rate = exp(-decay_params.rate * (correlation - adaptive_entry_correlation) / (1.0 - adaptive_entry_correlation)). Maps correlation from [adaptive_entry_correlation, 1.0] to a rate that decays exponentially from ~1.0 toward 0.0. The result is NOT floor-clamped — the caller (should_sample) applies min_floor after. This is a pure function with no side effects.

inputs.name: correlation
inputs.description: Current correlation score, expected to be in [adaptive_entry_correlation, 1.0].

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Decay function parameters. Uses params.rate (exponential decay constant).

postconditions: Return value is in [0.0, 1.0]
Return value decreases monotonically as correlation increases (for fixed params.rate > 0)

functions.name: linear_decay
functions.description: Computes sampling rate using linear interpolation: rate = low_correlation_rate + (high_correlation_rate - low_correlation_rate) * normalized_correlation, where normalized_correlation = (correlation - adaptive_entry_correlation) / (1.0 - adaptive_entry_correlation). Maps correlation from [adaptive_entry_correlation, 1.0] linearly between low_correlation_rate and high_correlation_rate. The result is NOT floor-clamped. Pure function.

inputs.name: correlation
inputs.description: Current correlation score, expected to be in [adaptive_entry_correlation, 1.0].

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Decay function parameters. Uses params.low_correlation_rate and params.high_correlation_rate.

postconditions: Return value is in [min(low_correlation_rate, high_correlation_rate), max(low_correlation_rate, high_correlation_rate)]
Return value varies linearly with correlation

functions.name: step_decay
functions.description: Computes sampling rate using a step function defined by an ordered list of (correlation_threshold, sampling_rate) pairs. Finds the highest threshold that is <= current correlation and returns the corresponding rate. If correlation is below all thresholds, returns 1.0 (full coaching). The result is NOT floor-clamped. Pure function.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Decay function parameters. Uses params.steps — must be non-empty and sorted ascending by threshold.

error_data.message: Step decay function requires at least one step in params.steps

preconditions: params.steps is sorted ascending by threshold (index 0 of each pair)
postconditions: Return value is in [0.0, 1.0]
Return value equals the rate of the highest step whose threshold <= correlation, or 1.0 if no step threshold is <= correlation

invariants: The scheduler is stateless — all state flows through the ConfidenceSnapshot parameter; no mutable instance state is modified after construction
At least one of send_to_local or send_to_remote is True in every SamplingDecision — requests are never dropped
is_coaching_sample is always equal to (send_to_local AND send_to_remote) — it is a derived field, never set independently
Budget exhaustion is the highest-priority override — when budget_exhausted is True, send_to_remote is always False regardless of all other conditions
Emergency threshold is the second-highest priority — when correlation < emergency_threshold and budget is not exhausted, send_to_local is False (local model is untrustworthy)
The min_floor is a hard minimum — in ADAPTIVE phase, the effective sampling rate is never below config.min_floor; spot-checking never stops
Phase determination is fully deterministic given the same ConfidenceSnapshot and config — only the random roll introduces non-determinism, and that is injectable

Override precedence is strict and total: budget_exhausted > emergency_threshold > coaching_trigger > staleness > min_sample_count_for_adaptive > adaptive_entry_correlation > decay_function + floor_clamp > random_roll
Config is immutable after scheduler construction — config values cannot change at runtime
All SamplingDecision instances are frozen (immutable) Pydantic models suitable for JSON serialization into the audit trail
Decay functions are pure — they have no side effects and always return the same output for the same inputs
The random source is called at most once per should_sample invocation, and only in ADAPTIVE phase when the rate is not 1.0
REMOTE_ONLY phase implies send_to_local=False, send_to_remote=True — this is the only phase where local model is excluded
LOCAL_ONLY phase implies send_to_local=True, send_to_remote=False — this occurs only when budget is exhausted
COACHING_FULL phase implies send_to_local=True, send_to_remote=True, sampling_rate=1.0
